reviewMethod: Personally viewed every original page image and compared all source-page English and Chinese content, mathematical formulas and hypotheses, proof steps, exercises, figure captions and diagram labels. Relevant saved crops were also viewed. Primary review flags were not used as substitutes for this comparison. Chinese wording was read under the clarified natural-expression preference; no extra explanations were introduced.
